notes: New. Edit a picture: open the extension and pick 'Edit a picture' to work on a file already on this PC - a screenshot someone sent you on Teams or WhatsApp, a photo, anything. Choose it, drop it anywhere on the page, or press Ctrl+V to paste one straight from the chat, then use the same tools you use on a capture. A picture too big for one image is made smaller instead of refused, and Recent keeps it like any capture. You can give it a keyboard shortcut of its own under Shortcuts.
